metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge - Waived with injury settlement
metadata.description: Hodge (knee) was waived with an injury settlement by the 49ers on Thursday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Hodge appeared in all three games for San Francisco, bringing in his only target for 18 yards. There's a chance the team will bring him back, so his days with the organization may not be finished.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge released by 49ers
metadata.description: The 49ers released WR KhaDarel Hodge with an injury settlement.
metadata.analysis: Hodge could return to the 49ers when he is healthy.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge's Opportunity Growing Amid 49ers Injuries
metadata.description: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver KhaDarel Hodge saw his role jump in Week 3, even if the box score did not show it. Hodge played 30 of San Francisco's 54 offensive snaps against Arizona after Mike Evans left with a rib injury, but he was not targeted. The playing time is opening up because the 49ers are thin at receiver, not because Hodge has suddenly become a major part of the passing game. Demarcus Robinson is on injured reserve with an ankle injury, while Evans did not practice Wednesday because of his ribs. Hodge has only one catch for 18 yards through three games, so the fantasy appeal is still limited to deeper formats. His own status needs watching too after he missed Wednesday's practice with a knee injury. If Hodge is cleared and Evans remains sidelined, there should be another path to meaningful snaps against Denver in Week 4.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge (knee) misses practice Wednesday
metadata.description: KhaDarel Hodge did not practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Hodge remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge - Dealing with knee injury
metadata.description: Hodge (knee) did not practice Wednesday, Vic Tafur of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: Hodge may have tweaked his knee during the 49ers' 36-30 win over the Cardinals in Week 3, when he played 54 offensive snaps without seeing a target from Brock Purdy. Hodge will have two more opportunities to log a full practice and avoid an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Broncos.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge - Sees spike in playing time Week 3
metadata.description: Hodge went without a target while logging 30 of the 49ers' 54 offensive snaps in Sunday's 36-30 win over the Cardinals.
metadata.analysis: With Mike Evans (rib) making an early exit from the contest, Hodge was the main beneficiary from a playing-time perspective. He finished second to only Deebo Samuel (40) in snaps among San Francisco receivers, but he ran routes on just 13 of his 30 snaps and failed to draw any looks from quarterback Brock Purdy. Even with injuries at receiver piling up for the 49ers, Hodge appears unlikely to emerge as a major part of the passing game.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge - Promoted to active roster
metadata.description: The 49ers signed Hodge from the practice squad to the active roster Wednesday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Hodge was on the field for the 27-7 win over the Rams in Week 1. He is now back on the active roster for the Week 2 meeting with Miami, though he will likely spend most of his time on special teams.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge promoted to 49ers' active roster
metadata.description: KhaDarel Hodge has been promoted to San Francisco's 53-man active roster.
metadata.analysis: Hodge is being promoted to San Francisco's active roster after an impressive performance on special teams in the 49ers' season opener last week. This also helps shore up the team's depth at wide receiver after placing rookie De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) on injured reserve. The veteran is unlikely to be relevant for fantasy purposes at any point, however.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge - Reverts to practice squad
metadata.description: Hodge reverted to the 49ers' practice squad Friday, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: Hodge played just one offensive snap in Thursday's 27-7 victory over the Rams in Melbourne, Australia. The wide receiver played 12 more snaps on special teams, where he recorded two tackles on kick coverage. The 31-year-old veteran player will likely see more action throughout the season as a special teams option for the 49ers.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge - Bumps up from practice squad
metadata.description: The 49ers elevated Hodge from the practice squad to the active roster for the team's Week 1 game against the Rams in Melbourne, Australia.
metadata.analysis: Hodge was released by the Falcons at the start of free agency in March and didn't garner any interest until he had a tryout with the Bills in late July. He eventually joined an injury-ravaged 49ers receiving corps on Aug. 5 but didn't survive roster cuts before being signed to San Francisco's practice squad. It's unclear if any of the other six wide receivers on the active roster will be healthy scratches, but even if he's available for the season opener, he likely wouldn't be in line for many offensive snaps with all of Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, De'Zhaun Stribling and Demarcus Robinson ahead of Hodge in the WR pecking order.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge - Signs with San Francisco's practice squad
metadata.description: The 49ers signed Hodge to the practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
metadata.analysis: The 49ers released Hodge during Sunday's cutdown day after signing the wide receiver in early August. The 31-year-old quickly accepted the team's practice squad invitation and will continue to provide veteran depth to the organization through the start of the regular season. Hodge participated in all three preseason games, catching seven passes for 71 yards.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge released by 49ers
metadata.analysis: Hodge could end up back on the practice squad with San Francisco.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge - Signs with San Francisco
metadata.description: The 49ers signed Hodge to a contract Wednesday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Hodge had a tryout with the Bills last Thursday, but the wide receiver will ultimately end up in California. The 31-year-old joins the 49ers amidst a near-unprecedented string of injuries. In the wide receiver room alone, Mike Evans (quadriceps), Christian Kirk (calf), De'Zhaun Stribling (hamstring), Jacob Cowing (hip) and Ricky Pearsall (knee) have already sustained injuries of varying severity. The mass loss of players means Hodge will be filling in for meaningful reps as the team continues its training activities.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge signs with 49ers
metadata.analysis: Hodge appeared in 12 games with the Falcons last season. He will compete for a depth role in the wide receiver room for San Francisco.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge - Tries out in Buffalo
metadata.description: Hodge tried out for the Bills on Thursday, Lance Lysowski of The Buffalo Newsreports.
metadata.analysis: Hodge was released by the Falcons in March with a shoulder injury. The veteran receiver has served as a depth wideout and special-teams asset throughout his eight-year career, and he'd profile for the same role if he does land another NFL opportunity.

metadata.title: KhaDarel Hodge works out for Bills
metadata.description: The Bills hosted WR KhaDarel Hodge for a workout.
metadata.analysis: Hodge spent the past four seasons with the Falcons in a depth role.
